name: MIURA
recognition: MICHELIN Guide Czechia: Bib Gourmand (selection revealed Dec 2025); Gault&Millau Česko 2025: named among the region's two top-rated restaurants
what_to_order: Chuť Beskyd tasting menu · Vegetarian tasting menu · Regional and international classics à la carte
reservation: Online booking via hotel site (slots 12:00-19:00) or phone
best_time: Lunch, then a walk in the Beskydy
notes: Listed with Bib Gourmand on guide.michelin.com Czechia list (read 2026-10-21); hotel site with live booking page (read 2026-10-21).
verdict: The strongest single address for regional cooking near Ostrava, about 40 minutes' drive south of the city.
caveat: A car trip from Ostrava; MICHELIN lists no opening hours, and booking slots online run 12:00-19:00 only.

name: Cattaleya
neighborhood: Villa Cattaleya, a forest-edge resort about 2.5 km from Miura
recognition: MICHELIN Guide Czechia: selected (no distinction shown); Gault&Millau Česko 2025: named among the region's two top-rated restaurants
what_to_order: Venison goulash soup with slivovice · Fallow deer, gingerbread, black pepper, berries · Smoked pork, red cabbage, klubko dumplings · Zander, bisque, noky, saffron
price_range: Tasting menu 2,990 CZK; wine pairing 1,990 CZK; non-alcoholic pairing 1,090 CZK (own site, read 2026-10-21)
best_time: Lunch in daylight for the forest view
notes: MICHELIN listing (read 2026-10-21); own site shows summer 2026 menu and current prices (read 2026-10-21).
verdict: The ambitious, priced-up option of the region; worth it if the day is a Beskydy day anyway.
caveat: Closed Monday and Tuesday per MICHELIN; tasting menu 2,990 CZK plus pairings.

name: HogoFogo Bistro
what_to_order: Duck rillettes with almond aioli and toast · Tonkotsu ramen · Pumpkin gnocchi with guanciale · Vdolek
price_range: Lunch set 320 CZK; mains 298-590 CZK (week of 19 Oct 2026)
notes: Own site shows weekly menu dated 19-23 Oct 2026 (read 2026-10-21); listed on visitostrava.eu.
verdict: The most consistently recommended bistro in central Ostrava; a good lunch for a cook.
caveat: Weekdays only (Mon-Fri); the Apetit piece notes it sometimes closes at weekends.

name: Stračena Garden
neighborhood: Svinov, next to the U Stračeny farm shop
what_to_order: Rib eye steak 300 g · Rozpečené tvarůžky · Nakládaný hermelín · Celé kuřátko z pod cihly
notes: Own site © 2026 with full price list (read 2026-10-21).
verdict: The farm-to-grill steak of Ostrava; near Svinov station.
caveat: Closed Sundays.

name: Bernie's Grill & Wine
what_to_order: Grill steaks · Prosciutto from its Prosciutto Bar
notes: Own site lists Oct 2026 events (wine tasting 21 Oct, Halloween party 30 Oct) (read 2026-10-21); on visitostrava.eu.
verdict: Central, long hours, wine-led; a safe dinner rather than a discovery.
caveat: The site names no chef or dishes; Gault&Millau toque count not confirmed (paywalled).

name: Harenda U Barborky
neighborhood: Petřkovice, inside the Landek Park mining museum grounds
what_to_order: Roe deer shoulder, rosehip sauce, herb dumpling with orange zest, lardo · Chicken terrine with pistachio, prunes, black-garlic mayo · Semolina foam with plums and gingerbread · Roast goose with lokše
best_time: Lunch after the Landek mine tour
notes: Listed on visitostrava.eu restaurants (read 2026-10-21); recommended in Apetit (11 Mar 2026); own site live but undated beyond © 2025.
verdict: The one table that puts you on Ostrava's mining ground; go for the mine, stay for the goose.
caveat: Closed Monday-Tuesday; own site footer still reads 2025 - confirm the November dates by phone.
hot_this_month: November 2026: the St Martin's goose with lokše, 6–17 November (own site, seen 21 Oct; confirm by phone).

name: U Jarošů
what_to_order: Husí hody · Tasting menus to order
notes: Own site news item dated 07.10.2026 (read 2026-10-21).
verdict: A neighbourhood house with a butcher's lineage; worth it in goose season.
caveat: Out in Poruba, 20+ minutes by tram from the centre.
hot_this_month: Autumn 2026: goose feasts announced 7 October (own site, seen 21 Oct).

name: Stará kuželna
what_to_order: Dršťková polévka · Smoked beef tongue, horseradish sauce, dumpling · Hungarian perkelt with tarhoňa · Zander fillet with lentil salad
notes: Own site weekly menu 19-23 Oct 2026 (read 2026-10-21).
verdict: A real kitchen behind a pub-style room; check the address before setting out.
caveat: Street address not given on the site read.

name: Ostrawica Lokál
what_to_order: Svíčková · Trout po mlynářsku · Soup of the day
notes: Own site shows lunch menu dated Wednesday 21 Oct 2026; listed on visitostrava.eu.
verdict: The easiest honest lunch in the centre.
caveat: Staropramen on tap, not a local beer.

name: Burfi
what_to_order: Kofta with tomato chutney sauce and rice · Broccoli sabji with rice · Sweet halva
price_range: Full menu 129 CZK (19-23 Oct, year not printed)
notes: Own site weekly menu 19-23 Oct (read 2026-10-21); listed on visitostrava.eu.
verdict: Cheapest honest lunch in the centre; three hours a day only.
caveat: Mon-Fri 11:00-14:00 only.

name: Los Dobrotos
what_to_order: Churros · Tapas boxes · Daily lunch menu
notes: Own site with 2026-dated images (read 2026-10-21); listed on visitostrava.eu.
verdict: Cheap, cheerful, central; churros as the reason.
caveat: Lunch menu posted as images only.

name: Happy Banh Mi
what_to_order: Phở bò chín/tái · Bún bò Huế · Bánh mì · Bún bò Nam Bộ
notes: Own site © 2026, notes Ostrava branch reopened (read 2026-10-21).
verdict: The pho stop in the centre.
caveat: Aggregator reviews are mixed beyond the bánh mì.

name: Pelmeški
what_to_order: Vareniky bramborové · Pelmeně Asian Fusion · Pelmeně kuřecí
notes: Own site © 2018-2026 with current prices; listed on visitostrava.eu (both read 2026-10-21).
verdict: A quick, filling eastern-European lunch near the centre.

name: Gokana
what_to_order: Yellowfin tuna tatar · Tonkotsu ramen · Gokana lunch set
notes: Own site lunch set dated 19-23.10.2026 (read 2026-10-21).
verdict: The reference sushi in the city.
caveat: Delivery-led site; closes 19:30 on the day read.

name: Drinkeat
what_to_order: Turkish eggs · Eggs Benedict · Roast beef on bread with a fried egg · Kefir pancakes
notes: Own site with October drinks menu; listed on visitostrava.eu (read 2026-10-21).
verdict: The breakfast to send a crew to.
caveat: Weekend hours only to 14:00.

name: Lajka žije
what_to_order: Seasonal breakfast · Specialty coffee and matcha
notes: Own site with 2026 menu files and photos (read 2026-10-21).
verdict: Coffee-and-eggs stop on the way to Slezská Ostrava.
caveat: Walk-in only; street address not printed.

name: CØKAFE Dolní Vítkovice
what_to_order: Breakfast · House cakes · A glass of wine
notes: Forbes CZ and E15, 27 Aug 2026 (Kofola stake); listed on the Dolní Vítkovice site, read 21 Oct 2026.
verdict: The best-located coffee in the city: breakfast here, then the blast furnace next door.
caveat: Now majority-owned by a drinks group; expect the house roast, not guest roasters.

name: Laura Coffee
what_to_order: V60 / batch brew · House bread and cakes
notes: Own site with 2026 news (Cascara, 18 Feb 2026; Christmas 2026 cookies), read 21 Oct 2026.
verdict: The coffee to grab at Svinov when you arrive by train.
caveat: The cafes are out of the old centre.

name: Shothouse Ostrava
what_to_order: Filter / batch brew · Street brunch
notes: Own site with hours and table booking, read 21 Oct 2026.
verdict: A good laptop morning in the centre.
caveat: Sunday hours are short (09:00-12:00).

name: Kavárna Elektra
what_to_order: Croissant Benedikt · Wiener Schnitzel · Reisauflauf
notes: Own site shows the weekly menu for 19-23 Oct 2026.
verdict: Ostrava's one proper grand-cafe room; go for breakfast or the lunch menu.
caveat: Weekdays only; closes 19:00.

name: Zámek Zábřeh — Pivovar Pikard
what_to_order: Seasonal beer specials · Martinmas goose
notes: Own site (c) 2026 with booking live, read 21 Oct 2026; listed as 'Pivovar Pikard / Zábřeh Chateau tour' in the June 2026 regional gastro guide.
verdict: The most atmospheric place in the city to drink beer brewed on the premises.
caveat: Out of the centre (Zábřeh, south Ostrava); the beer spa is a gimmick you can skip.

name: Heřmanický pivovar
what_to_order: Brewery tour with tasting · Metr piva
notes: Live tour offer and reviews to 15 Oct 2026 on a deal site, read 21 Oct 2026; no site of its own found
verdict: Book a weekday tour; this is where Ostrava's small-brewery scene actually lives.
caveat: Evidence is a deal-site listing, not the brewery's own page; book by phone at least two days ahead.

name: Pivovar Radegast, Nošovice
neighborhood: Beskydy foothills, 30 km south of Ostrava
what_to_order: Tour tasting · Radegastova škola čepování
price_range: Tour listed 250 CZK adult, 180 CZK reduced, 650 CZK family (Kudy z nudy, undated, read 21 Oct 2026)
notes: Listed with guided tours in the Moravian-Silesian Region's North Moravia Gastro Guide (June 2026); radegast.cz live 21 Oct 2026; took part in Noc pivovaru 24 Apr 2026.
verdict: The easiest serious brewery tour from Ostrava; pair it with a Beskydy day.
caveat: Prices and tour times below come from an undated Kudy z nudy listing that still shows an old SABMiller email: confirm with the brewery before you go.

name: U Zrzavé Mary
what_to_order: Small-brewery draught · Back-bar spirits
notes: Listed in the European Bar Guide's Top 100 Bars in Europe 2026 (page read 21 Oct 2026).
verdict: The late beer after the gig, not the first one.
caveat: Smoky-dive character; small independent beer range only.

name: Kurník šopa
what_to_order: Guest lagers · Bottle list
notes: Own site kurniksopahospoda.cz shows a tap list dated 20 Oct 2026 (read 21 Oct 2026)
verdict: Where Ostrava's beer people drink when they want something other than the big three.
caveat: The original Kurník šopa is a basement pub in Poruba, Pavlouskova 24.

name: HokusPokus
what_to_order: Wine by the glass · Sourdough bread · Pate
notes: Own site lists Ostrava tasting events 13 May, 14 May and 3 Jun 2026.
verdict: The best glass of wine in the city; Moravian bottles share the list with European natural growers.
caveat: Closed Sunday and Monday; not a Moravian-only list.

name: Winestone
what_to_order: Business lunch · Wine pairing
notes: Only a Kudy z nudy listing was read (21 Oct 2026); not confirmed on the hotel's own page
verdict: A safe hotel option for a glass with dinner, not a destination.
caveat: Moravian focus not confirmed.

name: NOX — Provoz
what_to_order: Bar drinks · Vinyl and books
notes: Provoz site lists events 24 Oct to 3 Dec 2026, read 21 Oct 2026.
verdict: The closest thing Ostrava has to a listening bar: records, books and a serious gig room.
caveat: Not a hi-fi bar in the Japanese sense; gigs carry a door charge (250-350 CZK for 24 Oct 2026).
hot_this_month: Autumn 2026: Market and Laokoon on 24 October, a record launch on 6 November, Power for Ukraine on 13 November (own site, seen 21 Oct).

name: Heligonka
what_to_order: Bar · Concert
notes: Own site lists concerts 25-28 Oct 2026.
verdict: Book a night Nohavica plays; it is Ostrava's songwriter in his own room.
caveat: Opens only on concert days, 18:00-21:00 box hours.
hot_this_month: Late October 2026: Jiří Krhut on 25 October, Jarek Nohavica on 26 October (own site, seen 21 Oct).

name: Dock
what_to_order: Weekend breakfast · Bistro plates
notes: Own site with hours, read 21 Oct 2026; Provoz event at Dock 27 Oct 2026.
verdict: The best single bar in Malá Kodaň, where Ostrava now goes out.
caveat: Bring cash for cup deposits.
hot_this_month: 27 October 2026: a Provoz night on the river (seen 21 Oct).

name: Folk Food
what_to_order: Chilli Folk dog · Cheddar Folk dog · Smoked gouda
notes: Listed on visitostrava.eu restaurants (read 2026-10-21); own site live with prices.
verdict: Fast, local, made in-house.
caveat: Own site footer still © 2025; no hours online.

name: FÆNCY FRIES
what_to_order: Fries with mayonnaise and red onion · Fries with cheddar dip and bacon
notes: Own site © 2026; visitostrava listing (read 2026-10-21).
verdict: A cheap late snack.
caveat: Prices and hours not on home page.
